name: Lancer
source:
One of the two Lancers that appear in the game; the servant of [url=/c3529]Toosaka Rin[/url]. He strongly resembles his Fate/stay night counterpart.

[spoiler]His true identity is Cú Chulainn, the great hero of Ireland. His Noble Phantasm is called Gae Bolg.[/spoiler]
